issues.display_title: Issue #1544: Tour Transfer (With or Without Tour Key) Not Working Anymore
issues.main_description_html:
Description

The Transfer Tour feature is broken — transferring a tour with or without tour key no longer works.

From the Transfer Tour modal, the user enters a destination Email Address, clicks Transfer, and selects a transfer mode from the dropdown:

  • Keep the Tour IDs
  • Get New Tour IDs

Neither option currently completes the transfer successfully.

Impact

  • Users cannot transfer tours to another account.
  • Blocking a real request: a user has 20 tours to transfer and cannot do it in bulk (no manual workaround acceptable).

Scope to investigate

  • Reproduce the failure for both transfer modes: Keep the Tour IDs and Get New Tour IDs.
  • Check the tour transfer endpoint/handler on the API for errors (recent regression — "not working anymore").
  • Verify transfer works both with and without the tour key.
  • Review recent changes/deploys that may have broken the transfer flow.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Transferring a tour with Keep the Tour IDs succeeds — the tour appears under the destination email account with the same tour IDs.
  2. Transferring a tour with Get New Tour IDs succeeds — the tour appears under the destination account with newly generated IDs.
  3. Transfer works both with and without a tour key.
  4. Bulk transfer of multiple tours (e.g. the reporter's 20) works without manual intervention.

Debug Results

At the end of the transfer process. The "transfer" worker does not hit the /v2/tours/clone-overlay-after-transfer api.

I added a "start clone overlay after transfer" log as a marker that the API was hit but it is not there when the log file is opened.

issues.display_title: Issue #1520: Migrate Street Editor: Stitching V1
issues.main_description_html:
Pattern: Category B — thin passthrough, already delegates to a legacy Action class. Wrap to strict ADR (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + ResponseEnvelopeHelper envelope). No logic change.

Endpoint:

Method Path Current handler
POST /streeteditor/v1/stitching StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@stitchingV1 → V1\Actions\StitchingV1

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md, docs/ARCH_RULES.md

Note from Developer

This issue is resolved via PR #1532. StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@stitchingV1 was migrated to strict Domain-Based ADR — mechanical wrap only, no behavior change.

Key changes:

  • New StreetEditor\StitchingV1Controller → StitchingV1Action + StitchingV1Dto
  • Proxies to a separate upstream from stitching/upload-stitching: the JSON stitch-api at BASE_URL_STITCHING_V1 (vs. the multipart BASE_URL_STITCHING microservice) — two independent stitching backends coexist
  • image_ids validation intentionally stays in the Controller (Validator::make) rather than a thrown domain exception, to preserve legacy's data.input field with per-field validator messages — same deliberate deviation pattern as the (not-yet-migrated) stitching-upload-v1 endpoint
  • Legacy StreetEditor\V1\Actions\StitchingV1 namespace dropped — new Controller/Action are flat under StreetEditor, not StreetEditor\V1 (route path v1/stitching unchanged, only the PHP namespace)
  • Adds StreetEditorStitchProcessingFailedException (local save of the upstream image fails), StreetEditorStitchOutputMissingException (successful upstream response without an image Content-Type)

Affected API endpoint:

Method Endpoint Description API Docs
POST /streeteditor/v1/stitching Proxies a JSON stitching request to the stitch-api upstream; saves and returns the resulting image (filename + URL) on success, otherwise passes the upstream response through as-is. stitching-v1.md (PR #1543)

Error domain codes introduced:

Code HTTP When
STREETEDITOR.STITCH_PROCESSING_FAILED 409 saving the successful upstream image body locally fails
STREETEDITOR.STITCH_OUTPUT_MISSING 409 upstream response successful but not an image Content-Type

issues.display_title: Issue #1521: Migrate Street Editor: Upload Stitching V1
issues.main_description_html:
Pattern: Category B — thin passthrough, already delegates to a legacy Action class. Wrap to strict ADR (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + ResponseEnvelopeHelper envelope). No logic change.

Endpoint:

Method Path Current handler
POST /streeteditor/v1/stitching/upload StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@stitchingUploadV1 → V1\Actions\StitchingUploadV1

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md, docs/ARCH_RULES.md

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1533 (se/1521-stitching-upload-v1, merged into se/1520-stitching-v1).

  • New StitchingUploadV1Controller / StitchingUploadV1Action / StitchingUploadV1Dto, replacing legacy StreetEditor\V1\Actions\StitchingUploadV1::execute(). The legacy StreetEditor\V1 Actions directory is now empty and was removed.
  • Migrated code is not namespaced under StreetEditor\V1 — flat under StreetEditor (route path v1/stitching/upload preserved; only the PHP namespace changed), same convention as stitching-v1.
  • Pure raw passthrough: the Action streams the uploaded file as multipart field image to {BASE_URL_STITCHING_V1}/upload (STITCH_API_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT, default 120s, floored at 120s if configured below 30s) and always returns the upstream status/body/headers unchanged. No domain exceptions, no failure branching in the Action.
  • image validation (required|file + explicit isValid() check) stays in the Controller via Validator::make, not a thrown domain exception — same deliberate deviation as stitching-v1, to preserve the legacy data.input (per-field validator error) response shape.
  • Talks to the same upstream as stitching-v1 (BASE_URL_STITCHING_V1), distinct from stitching/upload-stitching/delete-stitching (BASE_URL_STITCHING).
  • No new domainCode/HTTP exceptions — this endpoint has none (see table below).
domainCode HTTP Condition
(Controller-level validation, no domainCode) 409 image missing/not a file/invalid upload
(fallback \Throwable) 500/503 unexpected error, upstream stitch-api failure

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path API Docs
POST /streeteditor/v1/stitching/upload stitching-upload-v1.md (PR #1545)

issues.display_title: Issue #1522: Migrate Street Editor: Generate Thumbnail
issues.main_description_html:
Pattern: Category B — thin passthrough, already delegates to a legacy Action class. Wrap to strict ADR (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + ResponseEnvelopeHelper envelope). No logic change.

Endpoint:

Method Path Current handler
POST /streeteditor/generate-thumbnail/{panoId} StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@generateThumbnail → Actions\GenerateThumbnail

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md, docs/ARCH_RULES.md

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1534 (se/1522-generate-thumbnail, merged into se/1521-stitching-upload-v1).

  • New GenerateThumbnailController / GenerateThumbnailAction / GenerateThumbnailDto, replacing legacy StreetEditor\Actions\GenerateThumbnail::execute().
  • (Re)generates a 1500×750 equirectangular thumbnail from a panorama's full image via GD (getimagesize → imagecreatefromjpeg → imagecopyresampled → imagejpeg at quality 85).
  • Reuses four exception classes already bootstrapped for upload-stitching — no new domainCodes introduced: StreetEditorPanoramaNotFoundException (409), StreetEditorPanoramaImageNotFoundException (409), StreetEditorUploadFailedException (500), StreetEditorDeleteFailedException (500).
  • Thumbnail path derivation differs from upload-stitching: always {full_image_dirname}/{full_image_filename}_thumb.jpg, rather than reading the panorama's thumb_local_path column.
  • No ownership check on panoId — this is a self-use/internal endpoint, matches legacy.
  • messages.success_generate_thumbnail has no entry in resources/lang/en/messages.php, resolves to the literal key string — preserved bug-for-bug from legacy.
domainCode HTTP Condition
STREETEDITOR.PANORAMA_NOT_FOUND 409 no panorama row for panoId
STREETEDITOR.PANORAMA_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND 409 panorama's full image file missing on disk
STREETEDITOR.UPLOAD_FAILED 500 getimagesize / imagecreatefromjpeg / imagejpeg failure
STREETEDITOR.DELETE_FAILED 500 unlink() failure removing an existing thumbnail

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path API Docs
POST /streeteditor/generate-thumbnail/{panoId} generate-thumbnail.md (PR #1546)

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1536 (se/1524-progress-apply-template, merged into se/1523-auto-connect-status) — the last Street Editor Category B endpoint in this migration batch.

  • New GetProgressApplyTemplateController / GetProgressApplyTemplateAction / GetProgressApplyTemplateDto, replacing legacy StreetEditor\Actions\GetProgressApplyTemplate::execute().
  • Pure read, no domain exceptions: status_apply_template reads Redis key apply_template_status_{moderationId} (RedisClass::connectRedisToronto()), defaulting to DONE if the key is missing or the decoded payload has no status. status_auto_connect uses new StreetEditorRepository::findAutomoderationProgressRow() to distinguish NOT_EXIST (no row) from IN_PROGRESS/DONE (row exists), matching legacy's !empty($progress) check.
  • Route stays outside auth, no ownership check — matches legacy exactly.
  • This PR deleted the now-empty legacy StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers.php and its Actions/ directory — the whole Street Editor domain is now single-action controllers.
  • No new domainCodes/exceptions introduced.
